name: Tolulope A. Kayode, PhD
bio: Dr. Kayode is a molecular epidemiologist studying malaria and other vector-borne and emerging infections, with a focus on diagnostics, transmission, and drug resistance. He holds a BSc and MSc in Microbiology and a PhD in Molecular Biology and Genomics. He completed his postdoctoral training at the University of Notre Dame, USA. He enjoys mentoring students and participating in community activities. Outside work, he enjoys spending time with his family, watching anime, and supporting Chelsea FC. His Christian faith is an important part of his life, and he enjoys reading and writing Christian literature.
